entries.title: Reset Infinitary leaves no working copy listed in your own projects
entries.body: When Reset Infinitary discarded a task, it could occasionally check your project's working copies while the task's own copy was still being put away. That copy then stayed listed in your project, pointing at a folder the reset had deleted. The reset now waits until each discarded task's copy is put away before it removes their links.
entries.noPicture: This changes what the reset leaves in a project's git records, not how any view looks.
